EOI - Malawi - Feasibility Study and the Drafting of Specifications for the National Investment Portal - DFIC
02-Jul-2025
The overall objective of the consultancy assignment is to conduct a feasibility study for the implementation of a national investment portal for the Ministry of Trade, draft technical specifications and tender documents required for the implementation and finally, sensitize stakeholders staff in relation to digitization and national investment portals.
